prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-definition ASCII illustration for the upper-left margin of a calm personal website.
Input images: Image 1 is a cloud drawing, used ONLY as a reference for palette and character-built texture. Image 2 is an ASCII bird, used ONLY to demonstrate large, legible character construction. Draw a NEW subject, not another version of that bird.
Style: build the entire subject from discrete, bold upright monospaced ASCII letters and punctuation such as @ O # % + = / : . . Each glyph should remain individually visible with white spaces around it. Use coarse characters (roughly 35–55 pixels wide at a 1536-pixel canvas width), with no fine engraving, stippling, painterly underdrawing, smooth solid silhouette, or vector outline. The thumbnail will be only 100–150 CSS pixels wide, so avoid micro-detail.
Palette: muted blue-teal and charcoal-green ink in shaded parts, warm ivory and honey-gold highlights, matching the references. Restrained saturation. Plain PURE WHITE background #ffffff with no paper grain, tint, vignette, shadow, frame, or border. Keep all ink inside the canvas with a clear white perimeter. No written captions, logos, watermark, interface, or explanatory diagrams.
Primary request: a single elegant red-crowned crane flying horizontally to the RIGHT. Give it the unmistakable elongated neck stretching forward, small head and slender beak, compact body, and two long fine legs trailing behind. Two broad rounded wings in a shallow, slightly asymmetric gliding posture; one farther wing is foreshortened. Natural anatomy, quiet movement. Avoid tall upright spear-like wings and forked swallow tails. A tiny muted rust crown is optional, not a bright red spot. The drawing spans most of a 3:2 landscape canvas; leave 6% white margins. No clouds in this asset: it will be placed over the existing cloud drawing in the webpage.
conversion: cwebp -q 94 -m 6; native dimensions; no crop, resize or repaint
